Boom! Apple's Full Disk Access changes arrive in latest macOS 27.3 beta. Mac users can now: • Limit an app to specific folders, not the whole Mac • Get clearer warnings about what’s being handed over • Limit which apps a tool can control • Have option to make apps re-ask for access • Menu bar indicator when one app controls another Full Disk Access is NOT going away, and anything already approved keeps its access.

macOS 27.3 includes new privacy controls for Full Disk Access and more - 9to5Mac

From 9to5mac.com

summary: Greg Joswiak on X: Over 200,000 apps are now optimized for iPhone Duo! That number DOUBLED in just over a week. I’m back on my Duo review unit to test the new face unlock feature, and I’ve already noticed more apps are Duo optimized. Oddly enough, the first one I checked that still isn’t Duo-optimized is Apple’s own Apple Store app , which was last updated…
title: Developers Continue to Optimize iPhone Apps for the Duo
